questions.text: Which were the main aspects/feature of the Regulating Act?
questions.text_as_printed: Which were the main aspects/feature of the Regulating Act? (April 2021) (Average)

answer.value:
The Bengal province gained control over Madras and Bombay presidencies.
The Governor General of Bengal became the Governor General of all the three presidencies.
The Governor General was authorized to direct, exercise control and to supervise over the other two presidencies
The Bombay and Madras presidencies could not declare war on anyone or entre into peace agreements without prior approval of the Governor General of Bengal Presidency
Only during the acute emergencies, they were entitled to act independently
According to this Act, Supreme Court was established in Calcutta.
In this central court, one Chief Justice and three ordinary judges were officiating.
